_how: Copy to library.json. Newest first. kits = starter kits from long-form episodes, one card each: tag (a key of site.chips in config.json), tab (the folder-tab label), blurb, optional meta (small grey line), optional code (a terminal-style snippet: '> ' lines are prompts, '#' lines are headings, ' # ' starts a comment), optional wide (a card across both columns), link (stays behind the email box). tools = repos and apps from your Reels, one list. Then: python3 site/publish.py --deploy

kits.title: Your first starter kit
kits.blurb: One or two plain sentences: what the file does, who it is for, and what they get after one message.
kits.code:
> set me up
✓ done in one message

tools.name: A free tool from a Reel
tools.blurb: One line on what it does for the viewer.
